RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Exchange (Deleg.name: RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Exchange
RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Exchange (Deleg.description: Allows the app to read and manage the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your organization's Exchange Online service, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading, creating, updating, and deleting Exchange management role definitions, role groups, role group membership, role assignments, management scopes, and role assignment policies.
